File Information
Collection: Inventory Management API (Assignment 12)
Environment: Inventory API - Local
Collection Description
Postman collection for the inventory-backend REST API (Node.js + Express, in-memory array storage). Start the server with `npm run dev` and select the "Inventory API - Local" environment (or use the collection variable baseUrl). - **Quick demo** folder: send any request on its own (filters and search use the 8 sample items; update/delete create a demo item first if needed). - **Folders 0-6**: the full automated test suite. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner: folder 2 creates the test items that folders 3-5 use, and folder 5 deletes them again. Every request has tests; a collection-level test checks that every response is JSON with the standard success/error shape.
